verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents broad first-party API coverage across its main product areas: connected-account creation, card issuing and authorization controls, card expenses, bills, single and batch transfers, and FX conversion. It backs this with SDKs, a CLI, and AgentOS for agents acting on production accounts. However, no evidence explicitly claims or shows that the API matches everything the dashboard can do, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: an explicit documented statement of UI/API parity, evidence covering dashboard-only areas (e.g., account settings, user/team management, approvals), and independent or hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Programmatically create connected accounts for businesses and individuals, and enable them with rich financial capabilities.
The Card Expenses API lets you retrieve approved card expenses from Airwallex and mark them as synced after ingesting them into your ERP or accounting system.
The Bills API lets you create and manage invoices received from vendors for goods or services.
Access interbank FX rates and programmatically manage currency risk.
Airwallex AgentOS is a toolkit for AI agents that need to act on your production Airwallex account — reading balances, creating beneficiaries, issuing cards, building cashflow reports
The Airwallex CLI lets you work with your Airwallex account directly from a command line.
